I have this MWE:

import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Bicategory.Adjunction.Basic
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Bicategory.FunctorBicategory.Pseudo

namespace CategoryTheory.Bicategory

open Category Bicategory

universe w₁ w₂ v₁ v₂

open scoped Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans

structure PreBiequivalence (B C : Type*) [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} B] [Bicategory.{w₂, v₂} C] where
  hom : B ⥤ᵖ C
  inv : C ⥤ᵖ B
  unit : Pseudofunctor.id B ≌ hom.comp inv
  counit : inv.comp hom ≌ Pseudofunctor.id C

variable {B C : Type*} [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} B] [Bicategory.{w₂, v₂} C]

def refl : PreBiequivalence B B where
  hom := Pseudofunctor.id B
  inv := Pseudofunctor.id B
  unit := {
    hom := {
      app _ := 𝟙 _
      naturality _ := {
        hom := (ρ_ _).hom ≫ (λ_ _).inv
        inv := (λ_ _).hom ≫ (ρ_ _).inv } }
    inv := {
      app _ := 𝟙 _
      naturality _ := {
        hom := (ρ_ _).hom ≫ (λ_ _).inv
        inv := (λ_ _).hom ≫ (ρ_ _).inv } }
    unit := {
      hom := {
        as := {
          app _ := (λ_ _).inv
          naturality _ := by simp [←leftUnitor_inv_whiskerRight] } }
      inv := {
        as := {
          app x := (λ_ (𝟙 x)).hom
          naturality f := by simp only [Pseudofunctor.id_toPrelaxFunctor, PrelaxFunctor.id_toPrelaxFunctorStruct,
    PrelaxFunctorStruct.id_toPrefunctor, Prefunctor.id_obj, Prefunctor.id_map,
    Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.categoryStruct_id_app, Pseudofunctor.comp_toPrelaxFunctor,
    PrelaxFunctor.comp_toPrelaxFunctorStruct, PrelaxFunctorStruct.comp_toPrefunctor, Prefunctor.comp_id,
    Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.comp_app, unitors_inv_equal,
    Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.categoryStruct_comp_naturality_hom, whiskerRight_id, assoc, whiskerLeft_comp,
   id_whiskerLeft, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, ←leftUnitor_inv_whiskerRight, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.categoryStruct_id_naturality_hom, whiskerLeft_rightUnitor]
                             rw [←assoc ((α_ f _ _).inv), ←whiskerLeft_rightUnitor, unitors_equal, ←comp_whiskerRight, unitors_equal, Iso.inv_hom_id, id_whiskerRight]
                             nth_rewrite 2 [←assoc (f ◁ (ρ_ (𝟙 _)).hom)]
                             rw [←assoc ((f ◁ (ρ_ (𝟙 _)).hom ≫ (ρ_ f).hom)), assoc (f ◁ (ρ_ (𝟙 _)).hom)]
                             have := comp_id (f ◁ (ρ_ (𝟙 _)).hom ≫ (ρ_ f).hom ≫ (λ_ f).inv)
        }
      }
    }
  }

All looks well and we're so very close to closing the goal, but adding a humble exact this.symm or rw [this] seems to make Lean completely freeze up for me. I've let it run for a couple hours and it hasn't stopped from "processing file". I've tried doing some other proofs: Just simp from the very start also causes it to hang in the same way, for example. Can anyone else recreate this issue? Is there anything that can be done?

Excuse the current inefficiency of this proof, I've been trying to figure out how to curtail this issue for some time now.
This is the fault of the autoparams: add sorried inv_hom_id and hom_inv_ind and it works

(also, this kind of goal is happily solved by bicategory: )

import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Bicategory.Adjunction.Basic
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Bicategory.FunctorBicategory.Pseudo

namespace CategoryTheory.Bicategory

open Category Bicategory

universe w₁ w₂ v₁ v₂

open scoped Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans

structure PreBiequivalence (B C : Type*) [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} B] [Bicategory.{w₂, v₂} C] where
  hom : B ⥤ᵖ C
  inv : C ⥤ᵖ B
  unit : Pseudofunctor.id B ≌ hom.comp inv
  counit : inv.comp hom ≌ Pseudofunctor.id C

variable {B C : Type*} [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} B] [Bicategory.{w₂, v₂} C]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
def refl : PreBiequivalence B B where
  hom := Pseudofunctor.id B
  inv := Pseudofunctor.id B
  unit := {
    hom := {
      app _ := 𝟙 _
      naturality _ := {
        hom := (ρ_ _).hom ≫ (λ_ _).inv
        inv := (λ_ _).hom ≫ (ρ_ _).inv } }
    inv := {
      app _ := 𝟙 _
      naturality _ := {
        hom := (ρ_ _).hom ≫ (λ_ _).inv
        inv := (λ_ _).hom ≫ (ρ_ _).inv } }
    unit := {
      hom := {
        as := {
          app _ := (λ_ _).inv
          naturality _ := by simp [←leftUnitor_inv_whiskerRight] } }
      inv := {
        as := {
          app x := (λ_ (𝟙 x)).hom
          naturality f := by
            dsimp
            bicategory
        }
      }
      hom_inv_id := by
        ext
        simp
      inv_hom_id := by
        dsimp
        ext
        simp
    }
    counit := sorry
  }
  counit := sorry
What is concerning is that now that I have this working version I still have a runaway lean process eating my CPU from the version that had the autoparam looping... This one is definitely bad.

(Also, for very nested structures like this, it is now possible to "flatten" them, which leads to less { } everywhere, which I find is very nice.)

full construction of refl

import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Bicategory.Adjunction.Basic
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Bicategory.FunctorBicategory.Pseudo

namespace CategoryTheory.Bicategory

open Category Bicategory

universe w₁ w₂ v₁ v₂

open scoped Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans

structure PreBiequivalence (B C : Type*) [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} B] [Bicategory.{w₂, v₂} C] where
  hom : B ⥤ᵖ C
  inv : C ⥤ᵖ B
  unit : Pseudofunctor.id B ≌ hom.comp inv
  counit : inv.comp hom ≌ Pseudofunctor.id C

variable {B C : Type*} [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} B] [Bicategory.{w₂, v₂} C]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
def refl : PreBiequivalence B B where
  hom := Pseudofunctor.id B
  inv := Pseudofunctor.id B
  unit.hom.app _ := 𝟙 _
  unit.hom.naturality _ :=
    { hom := (ρ_ _).hom ≫ (λ_ _).inv
      inv := (λ_ _).hom ≫ (ρ_ _).inv }
  unit.inv.app _ := 𝟙 _
  unit.inv.naturality _ :=
    { hom := (ρ_ _).hom ≫ (λ_ _).inv
      inv := (λ_ _).hom ≫ (ρ_ _).inv }
  unit.unit.hom.as.app _ := (λ_ _).inv
  unit.unit.hom.as.naturality _ := by dsimp; bicategory
  unit.unit.inv.as.app _ := (λ_ _).hom
  unit.unit.inv.as.naturality _ := by dsimp; bicategory
  unit.unit.hom_inv_id := by ext; simp
  unit.unit.inv_hom_id := by ext; simp
  unit.counit.hom.as.app _ := (ρ_ _).hom
  unit.counit.hom.as.naturality := by simp
  unit.counit.inv.as.app _ := (ρ_ _).inv
  unit.counit.inv.as.naturality := by simp [← unitors_inv_equal]
  unit.counit.hom_inv_id := by ext; simp
  unit.counit.inv_hom_id := by ext; simp
  unit.left_triangle := by ext; simp [leftZigzag, bicategoricalComp]
  counit.hom.app _ := 𝟙 _
  counit.hom.naturality _ :=
    { hom := (ρ_ _).hom ≫ (λ_ _).inv
      inv := (λ_ _).hom ≫ (ρ_ _).inv }
  counit.inv.app _ := 𝟙 _
  counit.inv.naturality _ :=
      { hom := (ρ_ _).hom ≫ (λ_ _).inv
        inv := (λ_ _).hom ≫ (ρ_ _).inv }
  counit.unit.hom.as.app _ := (λ_ _).inv
  counit.unit.hom.as.naturality _ := by dsimp; bicategory
  counit.unit.inv.as.app _ := (λ_ _).hom
  counit.unit.inv.as.naturality _ := by dsimp; bicategory
  counit.unit.hom_inv_id := by ext; simp
  counit.unit.inv_hom_id := by ext; simp
  counit.counit.hom.as.app _ := (ρ_ _).hom
  counit.counit.hom.as.naturality := by simp
  counit.counit.inv.as.app _ := (ρ_ _).inv
  counit.counit.inv.as.naturality := by simp [← unitors_inv_equal]
  counit.counit.hom_inv_id := by ext; simp
  counit.counit.inv_hom_id := by ext; simp
  counit.left_triangle := by ext; simp [leftZigzag, bicategoricalComp]
